about:
👋 Hello, I'm Jeff.

I started my career as a consultant helping big companies make more profit. Then at Google, I helped one giant company make (even) more profit.

Now, as one of the largest online educators in the world, I help professionals like you make more progress. 😉

experience.description: 🌟 My North Star: Creating content that makes a tangible impact on your life.

As the App Developer Marketing Lead for Greater China (GRCN), I manage a team of 5 to drive App Campaign revenue (a developer-specific product under Google Ads)

Highlights:

• Established annual tentpole event - Start on Android (应用出海计划) - in 2018 and is currently the largest contributor to our lead generation efforts (responsible for ~15% of our annual app developer leads)

• Developed partnerships with 5 creative agencies across APAC region to deliver ad creatives for our export-focused GRCN developers; average CPI decreased by 52% for our clients while campaign achieves an average ROI of 15x (as measured by incremental quarterly spend/cost)

• 20% Projects: I host at least 1 G2G (Googler-to-Googler) session per quarter with topics around Inbox Management, Productivity, Behavioral Economics, and Health & Fitness; attendee feedback score of 4.95 vs. L&D (Learning and Development) average of 4.6

Enabled export-focused SMB businesses in Greater China through a mixture of international marketing, sales, and expansion strategies
• Managed over 10 key accounts in e-Commerce, hospitality, travel, education, and B2B verticals
• Partnered with C-level stakeholders to develop long-term online and offline marketing strategies with prioritization on sustainable business growth
• Crafted and currently managing a digital marketing playbook for Chinese B2B businesses
• Developed scalable online digital marketing training programs tailored for GRCN advertisers

Created and implemented training program for new Account Managers using interactive videos; program has rolled out across APAC region and ramp-up time has decreased by 30%

Worked on projects across the U.S and APAC regions.

Selected Project Experiences:

• Performed FTE analysis for "Big Four" global advertising company and identified lack of an operations function as area of improvement; implementation of operations group decreased administrative hours by 10%, resulting in $0.5MM in cost-savings

• Managed a Trade Route transition as PMO lead for multinational pharmaceutical company; performed gap analysis by geographical location, conducted interviews to understand financial and timeline feasibility, and established risk management protocols

• Assisted a multinational confectionery, food and beverage conglomerate with supply chain analytics and process improvement. Performed safety stock modelling and calculation and presented findings to senior management. Cost modelling resulted in total cost savings of $11MM, safety stock calculation in projected savings of $3.5MM over two years

• Supported an international education and publishing company in creating and deploying a cloud-based Google Development Product solution for client sales, validation, and approval teams. Documented current state and future state process maps for each stakeholder group. Implementation of solution decreased process cycle time from 3 weeks to 2 days

receivedRecommendations.description:
Jeff has a natural talent for connecting with his audience in a fast, clear and informative manner. 

As a Google Workspace user there are so many tools at your fingertips! It can be overwhelming and also counterproductive when you reinvent the wheel every time you could be streamlining the way you do things. 

Jeff's Workspace toolkit provides a collection of tried-and-tested tips, methods and templates which help to streamline your workflow, and keep your focus where it needs to be.

If you haven't seen Jeff's Workspace Toolkit, go check it out! https://academy.jeffsu.org/workspace-toolkit
